name: directive-naming-the-base-of-a-derived-code
description: A directive is in effect only for the finding the declaration would carry: an exported function of an internal package nothing outside can import would be reported under the unreachable-export code, so a directive naming the unused-exported code is stale, and its mark still keeps the function from being reported.
pending: suppression.md Staleness: the Go analyzer compares a record's code with the would-be finding's only for the three unused codes.
